input.text:
version: 1
project: shop
dependencies:
  kafka:
    settings:
      KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS: ${endpoint}
      KAFKA_KIND: ${kind}
  payments:
    settings:
      PAYMENTS_URL: ${endpoint}
      PAYMENTS_HOST: ${host}
      PAYMENTS_PORT: ${port}
      PAYMENTS_CREDENTIALS: ${credentials}
environments:
  local:
    runtime: podman
    dependencies:
      kafka:
        twin:
          image: lawtwin/kafka
          version: 0.1.0
          conformance: unrated
          ports: [9092, 9644]
          config: {seed: 42}
          env: {LOG_LEVEL: debug}
      payments:
        twin:
          image: ghcr.io/example/payments-twin
          version: 2.0.0
          conformance: L1
          ports: [8080]
          endpoint: http://localhost:8080/v1
          credentials: env:PAYMENTS_TOKEN
    sync:
      - env_file: {path: .env.local}
  staging:
    runtime: aws
    cloud:
      modules: ../modules
      region: eu-west-1
      vpc_id: vpc-1
      subnet_ids: [subnet-1, subnet-2]
      cpu: 512
    dependencies:
      kafka:
        twin:
          image: lawtwin/kafka
          version: 0.1.0
          conformance: unrated
          ports: [9092]
      payments:
        real:
          endpoint: https://payments.example.com
          credentials: aws-secretsmanager:shop/payments
    sync:
      - aws_appconfig: {region: eu-west-1, application: shop, profile: connections}
